# moddotplot-rs v0.2.1

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.2.1 is a production-hardening patch and remains a functional preview. It does not
change the selected estimator, default scientific parameters, numeric tile bytes, or
quick-first interaction model.

## Highlights

* The real 256-register preview, 1,024-register detailed, and selectively refined
  production paths now have assertion-backed acceptance against complete canonical
  k-mer sets.
* Accuracy is reported as error in displayed `ANI_c`, without interpreting `ANI_c` as
  biological ANI. Both default tiers pass with sparse correction disabled.
* Every Wasm scientific cache key now contains the complete canonical configuration
  identity rather than relying on a subset of fields or the external 64-bit digest.
* The estimator sweep now reports `ANI_c` error variance and union occupancy and
  asserts the selected configurations.
* Annotation imports have explicit 512 MiB and one-million-matching-record limits. A
  generated one-million-record parser/publication gate is part of release validation.
* Legacy estimator-selection and fused-projection APIs are deprecated ahead of the
  v0.3.0 production-surface cleanup.

## Accuracy gates

| Tier | Mean absolute `ANI_c` error | P95 absolute `ANI_c` error | 0.80 crossing rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 256-register preview | 0.027657 | 0.225955 | 4.92% |
| 1,024-register detailed | 0.004658 | 0.023787 | 0.88% |

The preview remains deliberately rough and has no maximum-error gate. Thresholds above
the operational 0.80 floor are diagnostic sampling points, not biological categories
or release boundaries.

## Known limitations

The product remains a functional preview. Large-scale scheduler validation, numeric
and pixel goldens, sequence/axis sharding, compact chunked annotation publication, and
data/image export remain future stages. v1.0.0 is deferred until after additional
usability work.
